messages:
elena: Runtime v3.2.0 landed to staging ~2h ago. Quick smoke shows kernel selector picked a new quant path for llama3q builds and longseq tests flaked. Pin or rollback?

deploybot: scheduled canary report available: https://deploys.redwood/internal/canaries/1747070707 ; all checks passed except longseq-stress (10% failures).
mike: saw ~1.3x token latency on p3 for quant-v4b variants, memory pattern looks different. Not huge but reproducible.
ryan: if it's kernel selection drift we should pin runtime to 3.1 for that model cohort. Hotfix would be smaller risk than full rollback.
elena: agree. Proposed: soft-pin runtime=3.1 for model-group=llama3q-quant in staging+canary; open a hotfix branch and triage kernel diff. Hold prod unpin until patch.
jin: tagging @oncall for overnight monitoring and to block unpin during the change window (02:00-04:00 UTC).
mike: I'll open the rollback/hotfix PR and add comparison traces from viz. PR: https://git.redwood/p/runtime-hotfix/ramps-1747
deploybot: pin applied to cohort "staging-quant-llama3q" at 1747072000 by @elena. Pin config: ```
pinlist:
  - runtime: "3.1.0"
    models:
      - "llama3q-quant*"
    reason: "kernel-selector drift causing longseq failures"
    owner: "eng-runtime"
```
ryan: good. For release notes we should add a "compatibility note" indicating model binds that may see perf delta and instruct customers to pin if they rely on longseq stability.
elena: note for docs/release-notes: cc @product for customer comms. Add rollback criteria: >5% error rate OR >20% median token latency increase vs baseline => trigger rollback.
mike: added CRITERIA to PR and smoke-runner job to fail on those thresholds.
jin: will stand watch during window and escalate if we hit thresholds. :eyes:
elena: decision summary: soft-pin applied, hotfix PR in progress, prod unpin blocked until patch verified. I'll write a short blurb for the release notes and ops-runbook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
